evidence.detail: Align news item icons more neatly: moved icons from li:before to li a:before and added display:flex + align-items:center to .news li a
Yet more fiddling with news story icons: further refined icon width and centering
.news li a { display: flex; align-items: center; } vertically centers icon against text midline as requested

triage.notes: Both fixing commits are 12 days after the issue was filed (May 15 → May 27, 2024); issue was never closed.
triage.proposed_comment: Fixed in d52af9dd (May 27 2024) by switching icons to flex items inside `a` with `align-items: center`, so they align to the center of the text rather than the baseline. Further polished in cd3513ae. Current CSS at `shared_web/static/css/pd.css:2497` reflects the fix.

verify.final_comment: Fixed in d52af9dd (May 27 2024) by making .news li a a flex container with align-items:center. The emoji icons are injected via ::before pseudo-elements which become flex items in that container (see shared_web/static/css/pd.css:2523-2545), so they align to the center of the text rather than the baseline. Further polished in cd3513ae.

own_evidence.detail: Independently read: .news li a has display:flex + align-items:center; the ::before pseudo-elements (emoji icons) are declared with flex:0 0 auto inside that same flex container, so they participate in flexbox alignment and are vertically centered with the text, not baseline-aligned.
